reasoning_summary: The fix involves adding a conditional check to detect when a forward slash is being appended immediately after another forward slash. This is a classic boundary/validation check (a guard) to ensure that the output format remains valid JavaScript by inserting a space when this specific sequence occurs. It is not an algorithmic rewrite, but rather the addition of a missing guard condition to handle a specific edge case in the output stream.
evidence_used: The fix adds an 'else if (c == '/' && getLastChar() == '/')' condition.

The bug report shows that 'alert(/ / / / /)' was being incorrectly printed as 'alert(/ /// /)'.
